product.name: Squatch Cab
product.description: Cabinet impulse response loader: exact convolution with no added latency, then the browser rig's Low cut and High cut (2nd-order, Q 0.7 dB as WebAudio defines it).

files.name: Impulse response
files.note: A path in the saved state, not a parameter. Loaded, resampled and swapped off the audio thread, with a short crossfade.

params.name: Low cut
params.note: 2nd-order high-pass after the convolution, the rig's Cab Low cut (RBJ cookbook, WebAudio Q of 0.7 dB). It is always in the path, as the rig's is: 20 Hz is its lowest setting, not off.

params.name: High cut
params.note: 2nd-order low-pass after the high-pass, the rig's Cab High cut (same design as Low cut). At 16 kHz it still lifts 8 kHz by about 1 dB; it is never off.
